name: Verolus
source:
Verolus is a tall, adult, silver Om'veri with yellow eyes. Her back is covered with thick, dark spikes. Due to the significant number of horns on her head, Verolus earned the nickname "Sharp-horn."
Verolus is a fighter for justice, and her habit of intervening in the affairs of others whenever injustice is brewing (in her opinion) often creates problems for her. Verolus acts quickly, paying no mind to the circumstances, which makes her very easy to pick a fight with.
